Contract EnterValidatedCreditReferencesModule::chooseLoanRequest(requestid: Integer): LoanRequest {
	definition:
		obs: LoanRequest = CurrentLoanRequests->any(o|o.RequestID = requestid)
	precondition:
		CurrentLoanRequests.isEmpty() = false
	postcondition:
		let currentLoanRequest: LoanRequest in
		currentLoanRequest.oclIsNew() and
		CurrentLoanRequests->includes(currentLoanRequest)
}
